name: OpenAny
summary: Alephant AI LLC B2A marketplace: one MCP endpoint to browse APIs and models. Catalog free; pay per call; MIT MCP repo; no OAuth.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (listing-queue #50; operated by Alephant AI LLC, 28 Geary St STE 650, 586, San Francisco, CA 94108, US). OpenAny is a business-to-agent marketplace at https://openany.si/. Official company page and llms.txt (as of 2026-11-20) say the published catalog lists 159 models, 4,469 API endpoints, and 75 provider identities, and that counts describe listings, not runtime verification. The live hosted MCP intro (bare GET of https://mcp.openany.si, HTTP 200 text/plain, and the text/html Accept variant, both fetched 2026-11-24) says an agent can find and use 3,200+ APIs and 168+ AI models. The GitHub repository description for openanysi/openany-mcp uses the same 3,200+ APIs and 168+ AI models wording. The repository README on main (fetched 2026-11-24) instead says 4,400+ APIs and 168+ AI models, and also states that https://mcp.openany.si/mcp is the advanced full-catalog endpoint exposing 3,268 per-API tools across 45 providers. These official figures disagree and are recorded with their sources rather than merged. Terms of Service (updated 29 October 2026): use the service only if you can enter into the terms and have authority to act for any organization or account you connect (no explicit 18+ age is stated). Browsing the catalog, reading docs, creating an account, and creating an API key are free. Model and API calls are billed at the selected route's published rate; a free account or key does not include free resource usage unless an explicit trial or promotion says so. No OpenAny subscription is required for standard pay-as-you-go access. Sign-in and copied instructions do not authorize spending. Skills run in your agent; their model and API calls are billed separately. Pricing page: eligible new accounts can receive $0.50 in signup credits toward supported calls billed to the OpenAny balance. Displayed catalog prices are not a price lock. Credits are a shared prepaid balance, not a bank deposit. Top-ups may be by card, USDC, or x402; official docs say this guide does not publish a universal top-up fee and that you should check the payment quote for processing, conversion, or network fees. Direct x402 per-call payment is only where a listing supports it. Refunds (docs and Terms): contact support (team@openany.si appears on the docs site) about unused credits or a refund request with the payment reference; eligibility, amount, method, and timing need confirmation under the terms applicable to that payment. A failed or timed-out request, a cancelled recurring setting, or a confirmed blockchain transfer does not by itself trigger a refund. Privacy: optional Google Analytics 4 on public pages after permission. Official Terms: OpenAny does not persist the contents of API requests or responses as stored content; account, payment, and usage records are kept; selected providers receive the inputs needed to fulfill a request and have their own rules. https://github.com/openanysi/openany-mcp is MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Alephant AI LLC), not archived, created 2026-11-03 and pushed 2026-11-23T06:21:43Z (2026-11-23 07:21:43 Europe/Stockholm). The hosted marketplace is proprietary. Official MCP setup guide: the server exposes openany_overview, search_apis, get_api, and run_api; the first three read public catalog metadata; run_api can execute and charge. There is no OAuth flow. No key, top-up, wallet, or spend; tools were not called.

agent_access.notes: No OAuth. Public catalog discovery needs no key; official docs say run_api can execute and charge and that sign-in does not authorize spending. Bare GET of https://mcp.openany.si (and the trailing-slash twin) returned HTTP 200 text/plain markdown introducing the marketplace. GET with Accept: application/json or text/event-stream returned HTTP 405 text/plain "Method Not Allowed" with Allow: POST. Unauthenticated initialize and tools/list POSTs returned HTTP 200. Official setup guide names openany_overview, search_apis, get_api (catalog) and run_api (can charge). Use https://mcp.openany.si or https://mcp.openany.si/ (both 200 for bare GET). Tools were not called; no API key, wallet, or spend.
